evidence.observation: H701 reads 444.2 °C while H702 reads 70.3 °C and the reboiler vessel reads 72.2 °C, a pronounced unexplained discrepancy.
The discrepancy persists: H701 is 446.2 °C, H702 is 72.0 °C, and the vessel is 74.1 °C; these readings cannot distinguish actual localized overheating from a temperature measurement fault.
Column temperatures are 72.0, 63.5, 63.4 and 63.4 °C; distillate and reflux readings are 0.0 and 0.2. No composition measurement has been supplied.

args.missing_evidence: H701 operating setpoint, allowable temperature limits and heater power/status, plus an independent H701 temperature measurement and sensor diagnostics to distinguish overheating from sensor/readout error. Composition measurements and a separation target are needed to evaluate separation; pressure diagnostics are unavailable because those sensors are not installed.
